scope: Traffic overview, breakdowns, collection exclusions and historical provenance
baseline: Live Q5QTjqUJdccH-izrtOX3x with Umami 3.2.0; local checkout includes unshipped analytics work
evidence: Production PostgreSQL aggregates and gen-insights.mjs reviewed read-only on 2026-10-22
Live dashboard and GA4 reporting inspected in ego-browser

features.outcome: Source-aware anonymous visitor and tab-session labels
features.decision: Explicit source, filtering and cache freshness metadata; never infer source from payload shape or promise natural persons
features.acceptance: Measurement/reader and UI tests; pending candidate browser verification

features.outcome: Exclude internal QA and clear automation before collection
features.decision: Canonical hosts, admin routes, browser optout, explicit automation signatures across internal/Umami/GA4; no exclusion by browsing speed alone
features.acceptance: Policy and authenticated endpoint tests; pending browser checks

features.outcome: Preserve raw data while reporting one filtered population
features.decision: Read-only snapshot SQL, rule counts, consistent filtered overview and dimension breakdowns; high-frequency records remain review-only
features.acceptance: Pipeline tests and read-only production dry-run; pending

features.outcome: Historical backfill remains visible without invented row attribution
features.decision: Known log reported 232380 sends; approximate 2026-08-16 boundary; mixed provenance remains unverified at event level
features.acceptance: Historical-window tests; exact per-row attribution remains unavailable

features.decision: Stale fallback keeps source and original timestamp; sparse comparisons align by relative bucket time; missing filtered breakdowns fail explicitly
features.acceptance: Reader outage, stale-clock and sparse-bucket tests

remainingLimits: No exact natural-person identity or bot percentage is claimed
Old internal test events cannot be identified retroactively from a new browser cookie
Deployment requires an isolated production-baseline candidate; unrelated local WIP must not ship
Raw Umami realtime/API views do not automatically inherit curated historical reporting filters
